title: The price of a graphical computer, 1981 to 1984
description: Bar chart of launch prices of three computers with a bitmapped screen, windows and a mouse: the Xerox Star 8010 workstation, $16,595 (1981); the Apple Lisa, $9,995 (1983); the Apple Macintosh, $2,495 (1984). Data: the Wikipedia articles Xerox Star, Apple Lisa and Macintosh 128K.
heading: LAUNCH PRICE · US DOLLARS OF THE DAY
